contract: C12, the control door: docs/contracts/C12.md (board ab-v16.94.1). One JSON object per line on the service's control.sock. The daemon sends the requests (req); the service sends the answers (res) and the events (ev). Each request carries its provenance (by). The service and the daemon test against the same lines. The service's state for these lines, and the fake's state at its start (agent-browser service --fake): state. Its open prompts are p1 (host login.example, list owner-repo) and p2 (host cdn.example, list owner-repo); its list owner-repo holds a.example and old.example. The reads q1 to q5 give the keys of the data of status, lists_get, prompts_get, endpoint and sender (stage 1a, board ab-v16.94.2). The stored sign-ins (board ab-v16.97.1, the part "The stored sign-ins" of C12): the requests s1 to s27 run in their order after r13 with the fake values of state.sign_ins (the fake opens no seal), the bad requests b22 to b38 refuse a kind, a shape or a rule of record, and signInScan holds the canaries of the scan.

off.agent_text: The agent browser is not running.
off.operator_text: The agent browser is not running. A start on the Browser page starts it.

hellos.note: the hello of agent-browser service --fake (agentwatch's hermetic tests)
a newer daemon's hello: a field and a feature that the service does not know, which it ignores

badHellos.note: the daemon reads a hello whose side is not service (a process that is not the service, or a mixed-up peer): it closes the connection
the service reads a hello whose side is not daemon: it closes the connection
a hello whose v is not 1 is a new door: the reader closes the connection and sends no request and no answer

refused.note: the systemd query failed (m1): one line with the reason, then the service closes the connection

line.reason: The control door cannot read the MainPID of agentwatch's unit, so it admits no connection.

refused.note: a peer that fails a rule of 1 to 4 (here rule 2: its parent is not the MainPID): one line that names the rule, then the service closes the connection

line.reason: The control door admits only the agentwatch daemon process: rule 2 failed (its parent is not the MainPID of agentwatch's unit).

requests.note: config: agentwatch's browser.* keys as data, at each connect and each change
config with browser.control false: the endpoint and the MCP path answer the 503 of C11
set_sessions: a complete snapshot of three local sessions (each with its lifetime id, or null: web-2 has none), no remote scope before stage 5, and the box's own sign-in hosts and cookie names

status (the data keys of stage 1a): the state with the agent's text and the operator's text as two keys, Chrome's facts, the endpoint's form, the MCP's state (none before stage 1d), the sessions of r3, the lists, no stop yet, and the open prompts with their recipients; the stored sign-ins' state (none, before any op of the store)
lists_get: each list with its repo, its entries, the scopes that use it and its read error, and the old single list
prompts_get: the open prompts, each with its recipients (the session name and the lifetime id of each session that a block stopped; web-2's lifetime id is null, and web-2 is still a recipient)
endpoint: the endpoint's URL for the scope
sender: the sender's ID, its version and its package (here the fake's empty zip)
session_ended
launch_check of a name that is free
launch_check of a name whose ended scope is held in memory only

data.refusal: A session named web-1 ended a moment ago, and the agent browser could not record it (the file of ended scopes cannot be written: ENOSPC). Choose another name, or wait until the agent browser confirms its lists.

requests.note: an operator act from the web viewer with a password login: list_set adds and removes entries of one list (it never replaces the list)
an operator act: the allow of a prompt, with the host and the list that the operator saw
an operator act: the dismissal of a prompt
an operator act from the operator extension's send (C9): import, with a C2 payload (here a small one), answered with C4's import counts
a start with the API token (an agent's endpoint wait, or agentwatch browser start in a terminal): today's rule
a stop from the web viewer
a stop with the API token: today's rule, until the answer Q5 (ab-6ng)
sign_in_seal before the first sign_ins since the service's start: the snapshot comes before the state

res.error: the stored sign-ins have no snapshot yet

requests.note: sign_ins: the first snapshot of the store's files, with no key.json and no record (the store is not set up)
sign_ins_unlock in the state none: the store is not set up

res.error: the store is not set up

requests.note: sign_ins_setup (the operator in the Browser pane, with the pane's seal of the passphrase): the content of key.json; the store is open (a sign_ins event)
sign_ins_setup while the store is open: set up already

res.error: the store is set up already

requests.note: sign_ins with the new key.json: the store stays open (the same public half)
sign_in_seal by the operator: sealed with v 1, gen 1, repos null (Q2 b), by operator and approved true; the answer's record and the sealed part
an agent's offer (Q3 b; kind token from the daemon's walk): sealed with by offer, approved false and send_to [origin], whatever the request holds (here another origin, approved, by and repos)
sign_ins with the two records (the offer in the daemon's state offered)
sign_in_reseal: the operator's approval of the offer, with a new name: the record's by stays offer, approved true, gen 2
sign_in_reseal of an id that the last sign_ins does not hold

res.error: there is no stored sign-in with this id

requests.note: sign_in_reseal with another origin than the record's: a change of the origin needs the password again

res.error: a change of the origin needs a new seal of the password

requests.note: sign_in_seal with the rid of an earlier seal (s7): a replay is refused

res.error: the sealed value cannot be opened

requests.note: sign_ins_lock by the daemon (the uninstall): the store is locked (a sign_ins event)
sign_in_seal while the store is locked
sign_ins_unlock with a passphrase that does not open the wrapped key (the fake's wrong_passphrase)

res.error: the passphrase does not open the store

requests.note: sign_ins_unlock: the store is open again (a sign_ins event)
sign_ins_rekey: the new content of key.json (the same public half, a new salt and a new wrap)
sign_ins with the new key.json and the approved record (gen 2)
sign_ins with an old copy of a record (gen 1 after gen 2): a program of the user put it back
sign_in_reseal of the old copy: its gen is lower than the highest that the service saw

res.error: the stored sign-in cannot be opened

requests.note: sign_ins without c-3f9a2b7c: the operator removed it, and its id is a removed id from then on
sign_in_seal with the removed id
sign_ins_lock by the operator (a sign_ins event)
sign_ins with a key.json whose scrypt N (2^30) is outside the bounds: a program of the user planted it
sign_ins_unlock with the planted key: no derivation runs

res.error: the store's key file is not valid

requests.note: sign_ins with no key.json and no record: the operator removed all stored sign-ins; the state is none (a sign_ins event)

an allow from the daemon itself: never an operator act
an import with the API token
a start with kind daemon: start and stop take operator or token only
an op that the service does not have
a request with no provenance
a kind that does not exist
a via that does not exist
provenance with a missing user
the allow of a prompt that the service does not know
a session_ended whose scope does not match the scope pattern
the allow of a prompt whose host is not the one that the operator saw (the prompt changed): this prompt is gone
the allow of a prompt whose list is not the one that the operator saw
a list_set of the design's old form (the whole list in allow, no add and no remove)
a set_sessions with one root that breaks C11's root rule (pid 1): the whole snapshot is a bad request
a config whose chrome_args is not a list of strings
a stop with the token: allowed today; a stop by the daemon itself is a bad request
a set_sessions whose session has no lifetime_id (D11: each session carries its lifetime id, or null): the whole snapshot is a bad request
endpoint for a scope that the service does not have: no such session, not a URL
endpoint for a scope that ended (r4 ended web-1): no such session
a user that does not match agentwatch's user pattern (a newline, which could forge a log line): bad request
sign_ins_setup with the API token: never an operator act
sign_ins_unlock from the daemon itself: never an operator act
sign_ins_rekey with the API token
sign_in_seal with the API token and no offer: only the operator adds; an agent only offers
sign_in_reseal from the daemon itself: the approval is the operator's act
an offer with kind operator: an offer takes only kind token
sign_ins by the operator: the snapshot is the daemon's own request
sign_ins_lock with the API token: the operator or the daemon only
sign_in_seal whose sealed is a string, not a pane's seal
sign_in_seal with no offer field
sign_ins whose records is not a list
sign_ins_unlock whose pane's seal has no rid
sign_in_seal with an http: origin that is not a loopback host: the rule of origin

events.note: ready with an endpoint whose peer check cannot run
a new prompt: no URL path
a fail-closed stop: no confirmed receiver
a fail-closed stop: no complete set_sessions
a stop, with its caller's provenance
an error: a user, a domain and counts only
sign_ins: a change of the store's state, with the pane key's public half
sign_in at the start of an act: the live view sends no frame from here
sign_in at the end of an act: signed in, with the host of a request that the block stopped (never a path)
sign_in for a request that check 4 refused (the store is locked): an end with no start; the daemon sends one Web Push

newerEvents.note: an event of a newer service that the daemon does not know: it ignores it, as a field that it does not know

badLines.note: a line that starts with a byte order mark (EF BB BF): not a compact line; it closes the connection
a line that ends in CR LF: a CR breaks the compact-line rule; it closes the connection
a line with the bytes of a lone surrogate (ED A0 80) in a string: not UTF-8; it closes the connection

signInScan.note: The canaries of the stored sign-ins' scan (fake values): no line of these vectors holds one in a form of the guard (plain, URL-encoded, JSON-escaped, base64, base64url).
